# Awkward widget fixtures (#264)

Two fully synthetic PDFs, generated by `generate.mjs` with pdf-lib. No real person,
signature, account or private document appears in either file.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `awkward-widgets.pdf` | One page of deliberately awkward but valid widget data: a text field whose widget omits the Print flag, a 23pt option list in a 78pt box, a 24pt dropdown in a 31pt box, a `/MK /R 90` rotated text field, a check box with custom `/AP` art, a read-only value, a second check box without the Print flag, and `/NeedAppearances true`. |
| `xfa-form.pdf` | Minimal synthetic `/AcroForm` carrier with an `/XFA` packet. It is not a genuine LiveCycle form; it only proves that the editor refuses XFA before pdf-lib silently deletes the packet. |

```sh
node tests/fixtures/interop-264/generate.mjs     # regenerate both files
pnpm check                                        # structural export regressions
pnpm build && node scripts/awkward-fields-check.mjs   # real browser journey
```

`tests/export.test.mjs` asserts the exported structure. `scripts/awkward-fields-check.mjs`
opens the file through the public UI, edits it, saves, reopens the download and checks the
Print flag, the custom check-box art and the reduced choice sizes. It also checks the XFA
refusal and the damaged-file recovery. Neither check proves physical printing, an OS print
dialog or assistive-technology behaviour.
